summary.text: AJ Gubash is the Republican candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 53A in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a U.S. Army infantry veteran who works in legal support at a nonprofit public interest law center.

paragraphs.text: AJ Gubash said in a Ballotpedia survey that he grew up in Inver Grove Heights and served four years in the U.S. Army infantry.
He said he later deployed twice to Afghanistan as a military contractor, studied law and politics, and has worked in public policy and the legal field in Washington and in Minnesota.
Gubash listed restraining government spending, lowering taxes and fighting fraud, waste and abuse among his campaign messages.
He also wrote that he supports law enforcement, stronger consequences for violent criminals, and the right of law-abiding Minnesotans to defend themselves.
